subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Shared runtime object infrastructure reconstructed from validated function IR around 0x00497D20-0x00499E80: a surface loader that resolves a base directory, creates a surface through a global init object and registers 88-byte name/handle nodes in a per-object list; a sprite/texture slot registry comparing names; several intrusive node-list containers (head/tail/count getters, insert, value-set-plus-virtual-dispatch, two-list virtual iteration, object registration, teardown via virtual destructor and free wrappers); a dual-list container with a field-block initializer; a state-machine tree-traversal iterator and rendering-context setup helpers; a path/string registry entry family sharing a -1 empty sentinel and the default path global; a ten-slot record container with -1 id sentinels; and a family of thin stdcall delegates forwarding to the string-copy helper.

classes.name: SurfaceLoaderRegistry
classes.responsibility: Loads surfaces/textures by name and registers them in a per-object intrusive list. 0x00497D20 guards on a null name and a null global init object, is idempotent for already-loaded names, resolves the base directory from globals dword_5EC400/byte_5EA438, drives the init object at dword_8AC4C4 through vtable slots 0x44 (set base), 0x5C (create surface), 0x14 (validate), allocates an 88-byte node {name at +0, surface handle at +0x50, next at +0x54}, appends it to the list head this+0x10C and increments the counter at this+0x110. The list traversal field this+0x160 is recorded as read by the analysis table but no read appears in the raw source; it may be a provenance alias.

classes.name: SpriteTextureRegistry
classes.responsibility: Scans up to four sprite/texture entry slots on this (base this+1407 dwords, 3-dword stride) comparing a caller-supplied name against each active entry's string. 0x00498950 returns 0 on match or null input; with exactly three active entries it resets the default path global byte_5EA438 and invokes sub_495B60; otherwise it writes this+0xD8 into the target's string field. The entry-slot element structure is not evidenced.
